decisions.statement: The rebuilding this asks for is the rebuilding the timer asks for.
A run adds up the counts the day pages carry rather than counting the transcripts again.
A run that rebuilt no persona at all is refused.
A run works out no rung.
A run works today's count out again from today's own rows.
A run that stopped part way is refused naming each persona rebuilt before it stopped.
A run that stopped before it rebuilt a persona is refused as the fault alone.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.
A call saying any word is refused, because this takes no argument.

definition: the command working out again what each persona has earned
